violations.text: The presence of (drain flies/fruit flies) is not controlled as evidenced by (flies) located in various spot of establishment. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

At the time of inspection utensils in the front service area were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Methods for proper storage of in-use utensils were reviewed at the time of inspection. PIC empty water out of spoon container and turned on scoop wells at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine) sanitizing solution for the (3-bay sink and sanitization bucket). New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -2 door cooler racks -under top of prep unit lids -inside ice cream freezers -standing freezer shelf non-food contact surfaces shall be maintained clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The floors in the following area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris: -dry storage (old W/I cooler) -underneath and behind equipment The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
The floors throughout the establishment are in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet rooms must be self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 03/19/2026
The floor seal throughout the establishment is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026
